facts: Health Mutt, pet supply, Seminole Heights, Tampa. Address 5023 N Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33603. Phone (813) 231-3137. Website http://www.tampahealthmutt.com/ and https://tampahealthmutt.com/.
The homepage calls it a neighborhood independent pet market and says the staff is trained in natural pet nutrition and preventative pet care, for cats and dogs.

Services labeled on the site: pet grooming, self-service dog wash, and walk-in nail trims daily. Departments: dog food and supplies, cat food and supplies. The dog-wash line says you make the mess, we clean it up.
No weekly hours were printed in the homepage text we read.
